# Archived external listing artwork

These catalogue illustrations were used by external-play candidates that are no longer published. The static site must not copy this directory into `public/` or its deployment artifact. Each candidate in `../external-browser-listings.json` records its archived artwork path.

The artwork remains here only to preserve the repository research trail. It does not make any candidate a public listing or authorize game code, data, or other assets for redistribution. Reconsider a candidate only through local integration and rights review.
